items.description: A direct INSERT into stock_records with a NULL sku is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real branch database
A direct INSERT into stock_records with a NULL location is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real branch database
A direct INSERT into stock_records with a NULL quantity is rejected by the NOT NULL constraint on the real branch database, while a NULL tracking_code is accepted
A direct INSERT into stock_records with quantity below zero is rejected by CHECK ck_stock_records_quantity_non_negative on the real branch database

Downgrading the stock_records create migration to its own down_revision then upgrading head recreates the stock_records table with its columns, UNIQUE(sku, location) and CHECK(quantity >= 0) constraints (marked migration)
POST /api/stock for a new unique (sku, location) returns 200 with the filed sku, location, quantity, tracking_code and created=true
POST /api/stock with a brand-new never-seen location is accepted with 200 rather than rejected
POST /api/stock omitting sku returns 422 with an error naming the sku field
POST /api/stock omitting location returns 422 with an error naming the location field
POST /api/stock omitting quantity returns 422 with an error naming the quantity field
POST /api/stock with a null tracking_code is accepted with 200 and the record reads back with tracking_code null
POST /api/stock with a negative quantity returns 422 naming the quantity field and stores no row for that pair on the paired branch
The integration test session fails before any test runs unless DATABASE_URL is a postgresql URL to the paired branch (not sqlite or in-memory)
Every /api endpoint declared in api_contracts (POST /api/stock, GET /api/stock, GET /api/locations) responds with Content-Type application/json and never text/html

Playwright e2e client/tests/e2e/file-stock.spec.ts navigates the deployed app to route /file, fills field-sku (crypto.randomUUID-suffixed sku), a newly typed field-location, field-quantity and field-tracking-code, submits file-stock-submit against the live DB, and file-stock-confirmation appears showing that sku, location, quantity and tracking code
Playwright e2e client/tests/e2e/file-stock.spec.ts types a brand-new location into the field-location creatable combobox on /file and submitting it is accepted without a field-location error
A direct INSERT of a second stock_records row with the same (sku, location) is rejected by the UNIQUE constraint on the real branch database

Filing an existing (sku, location) through the repository upsert on the real branch database leaves exactly one row for the pair carrying the new quantity and tracking_code, scoped to the test's own unique sku
After re-filing an existing (sku, location), GET returns the new quantity and new tracking_code (updated in place)
Filing the same (sku, location) twice leaves exactly one record for the pair, with a single occurrence of the location in GET /api/locations
Filing the same SKU at two different locations yields two coexisting records, each independently retrievable with its own quantity
Filing two different SKUs at the same location yields two coexisting records, each independently retrievable with its own quantity
Filing the same (sku, location) twice leaves exactly one stock_records row for the pair carrying the second write's values
A re-file of an existing (sku, location) returns 200 with created=false, never a 4xx or 5xx

Playwright e2e client/tests/e2e/file-stock-collision.spec.ts files the same randomUUID-suffixed (sku, location) twice on /file with a different quantity the second time against the live DB, and file-stock-confirmation shows the new quantity with the file-stock-updated note
Playwright e2e client/tests/e2e/file-stock-collision.spec.ts re-files an existing (sku, location) on /file and no error alert or form-error is displayed, only the normal file-stock-confirmation

Playwright e2e client/tests/e2e/file-stock-collision.spec.ts re-files an existing (sku, location) with a different tracking code, then retrieves it via retrieve-form, and retrieve-result shows the second write's tracking code
GET /api/stock for a filed (sku, location) returns 200 with the same sku, location, quantity and tracking_code that were filed
GET /api/stock for a (sku, location) with no record returns 404 with a detail message
GET /api/locations includes a location after stock is filed there
GET /api/stock with sku and location returns exactly that pair's record when other pairs exist

Playwright e2e client/tests/e2e/retrieve-stock.spec.ts files a stock record under a randomUUID-suffixed sku on /file, then fills retrieve-form with that sku and picks retrieve-location, and retrieve-result shows the same sku, location, quantity and tracking code from the live API

Playwright e2e client/tests/e2e/retrieve-stock.spec.ts shows that after filing under a new randomUUID-suffixed location on /file, that location is offered as an option in the field-location combobox when the page is reloaded
